fields.name: amountOriginated
docs: The following fields are used by the FE only.

fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

instructions.name: addApprovedLender
docs: Lenders need to pass compliance requirements. Pool operator will administer off-chain
to make sure potential lenders meet the requirements. Afterwards, the pool operator will
call this instruction to mark a lender as approved.
Only pool operators can call this instruction.
Accounts executed instructions carry after those the IDL lists; the IDL does not describe them.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOperator} approves ${data.lender} as a lender in tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: addLiquidityAsset
docs: Adds an asset that can serve as the underlying asset for the pools.
Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} lets Huma pools use ${accounts.mint} as their underlying asset

instructions.name: addPauser
docs: Adds a pauser, who can pause the entire protocol.
* `pauser` - The address to be added to the pauser list.
Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} adds ${data.pauser} as a pauser of the Huma protocol

instructions.name: addPaymentDelegate
docs: Adds a payment delegate for a borrower.
* `account` - The pubkey of the payment delegate.
Only the borrower and EA can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} lets ${data.account} make payments on credit state ${accounts.creditState} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: addPoolOperator
docs: Adds a new operator to the pool.
* `operator` - The address of the pool operator.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} adds ${data.operator} as an operator of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: addRedemptionRequest
docs: * `lender` - The lender whose shares are being requested for redemption.
* `shares` - The number of shares the lender wants to redeem.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} asks to redeem ${data.shares} of ${accounts.trancheMint} of lender ${data.lender} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, to be processed when an epoch closes and paid out later: the tokens move from ${accounts.lenderTrancheToken} to the pool until then

instructions.name: addYieldDistributingLender
docs: Adds an approved lender as a yield distributing lender.
Only pool operators can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOperator} makes ${data.lender} a yield distributing lender of tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: approveCredit
docs: Approves the credit with the terms provided.
* `credit_limit` - The credit limit of the credit line.
* `num_periods` - The number of periods before the credit line expires.
* `yield_bps` - The expected yield expressed in basis points, 1% is 100, 100% is 10000.
* `committed_amount` - The amount that the borrower has committed to use. If the used credit
is less than this amount, the borrower will be charged yield using this amount.
* `designated_start_date` - The date on which the credit should be initiated, if the credit
* `revolving` - A flag indicating if the repeated borrowing is allowed.
Only the EA can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.evaluationAgent} approves a credit line for ${data.borrower} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}: limit ${data.creditLimit}, ${data.numPeriods} periods, yield ${data.yieldBps}, committed amount ${data.committedAmount}

instructions.name: approveReceivable
docs: Approves a receivable and adjusts available credit by applying the advance ratio.
Only the EA can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.evaluationAgent} approves receivable ${accounts.asset} for credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: cancelRedemptionRequest
docs: Cancels a redemption request submitted before.
* `shares` - The number of shares in the redemption request to be canceled.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} cancels ${data.shares} of ${accounts.trancheMint} from their redemption requests in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, returning them to ${accounts.lenderTrancheToken}

instructions.name: changeHumaOwner
docs: Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} makes ${data.newOwner} the Huma owner

instructions.name: changePoolOwner
docs: Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} makes ${data.newOwner} the owner of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: closeCredit
docs: Only the borrower and EA can call this instruction.

accounts.name: evaluationAgent
docs: The recipient of the rent refunds.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} closes credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: closeEpoch
docs: Closes the current epoch, handles tranche redemption requests and starts the next epoch.
We expect a cron-like mechanism like Autotask to call this instruction periodically to close epochs.
Anyone can call this instruction to trigger epoch closure, but no one will be able to

display.interpolatedIntent: Closes the current epoch of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, handling its redemption requests, and starts the next

instructions.name: closeLenderAccounts
docs: Closes the accounts owned by the lender.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} closes their lender state in tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: closePool
docs: Closes the pool after its maturity.
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can close a pool.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} closes pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: createHumaConfig
docs: * `sentinel` - The Sentinel Service account address. This is the account that handles
various tasks, such as AutoPay and starting a committed credit.
* `protocol_fee_bps` - The Huma protocol fee in bps.
Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

accounts.name: owner
docs: Address to be set as the protocol owner.

accounts.name: humaConfig
docs: Initialize config state account to store protocol owner address and fee rates.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} creates Huma config ${accounts.humaConfig} with treasury ${data.treasury}, Sentinel ${data.sentinel} and a protocol fee of ${data.protocolFeeBps}

instructions.name: createLenderAccounts
docs: Creates the accounts necessary for an approved lender.
Only the pool owner treasury, EA and other approved lenders can call this instruction.

accounts.name: lender
docs: PDA lender. Access is gated by the `approved_lender` check.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.payer} opens the lender accounts of ${accounts.lender} in tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: createPool
docs: * `pool_owner_treasury` - The address of the pool owner treasury, which will be responsible
for providing initial liquidity and receiving pool owner fees.
* `evaluation_agent` - The address of the Evaluation Agent, which is responsible for making
* `tranches_policy_type` - The tranches policy type that governs the profit distribution
Anyone can call this instruction. The signer will be designated as the owner of the pool.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} creates pool ${data.poolName} for ${accounts.underlyingMint}, with treasury ${data.poolOwnerTreasury} and evaluation agent ${data.evaluationAgent}

instructions.name: createPoolAccounts
docs: Creates various accounts needed by the pool.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.
Accounts executed instructions carry after those the IDL lists; the IDL does not describe them.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} creates the tranche tokens of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: createReceivable
docs: * `args` - The parameters used during creation. See the doc string for `CreateReceivableArgs`

accounts.name: asset
docs: The address of the new receivable.

accounts.name: owner
docs: This will be the `authority`, `owner` and `update_authority` of the receivable,
as well as the one paying for account storage.
Accounts executed instructions carry after those the IDL lists; the IDL does not describe them.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} creates receivable ${accounts.asset}, ${data.args.name}

instructions.name: declarePayment
docs: Declares a payment for a receivable.
Due to its self-declaration nature, this information is for transparency only and is not guaranteed
to be accurate. Some asset originators may choose to have an audit firm periodically certify the declared
Declaring a payment on a receivable here does not necessarily mean the same amount has been paid back
to the associated credit line. The receivable creditor is responsible for calling this function when
payment is received from the debtor.
* `payment_amount` - The amount of the payment being declared.
Only the update authority of the receivable NFT can declare a payment.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.authority} declares a payment of ${data.paymentAmount} on receivable ${accounts.asset}, for transparency only: no funds move

instructions.name: deposit
docs: LP deposits to the pool to earn yield and share losses.
All deposits should be made by calling this instruction and
`make_initial_deposit()` (for pool owner and EA's initial deposit) only.
Please do NOT directly transfer any digital assets to the pool,
which will cause a permanent loss and we cannot help reverse transactions
or retrieve assets from the contracts.
* `assets` - The number of underlyingTokens to be deposited.
The number of tranche token to be minted.
Only approved lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.depositor} deposits ${data.assets} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} into tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, for tranche tokens paid to ${accounts.depositorTrancheToken}

instructions.name: disablePool
docs: Disables the pool. Once a pool is disabled, no money moves in or out.
Any pool operator can disable a pool. Only the pool owner and the Huma

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.operator} disables pool ${accounts.poolConfig}: no money moves in or out until it is turned on again

instructions.name: disburse
docs: Transfers all the amount that has been redeemed but not yet disbursed to the lender.
Only lenders can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.lender} claims all the ${accounts.underlyingMint} owed to them from processed redemptions in tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, paid to ${accounts.lenderUnderlyingToken}

instructions.name: drawdown
docs: Borrows against an approved credit line.
Only the borrower of the credit line can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.borrower} borrows ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from pool ${accounts.poolConfig} on credit line ${accounts.creditConfig}, paid to ${accounts.borrowerUnderlyingToken}

instructions.name: enablePool
docs: Turns on the pool. Before a pool is turned on, the required tranche liquidity must be
Only the pool owner and the Huma owner can enable a pool.

display.label: Pool Owner Treasury Junior Tranche Token Account
Pool Owner Treasury Senior Tranche Token Account
Evaluation Agent Junior Tranche Token Account
Evaluation Agent Senior Tranche Token Account

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} turns on pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: extendRemainingPeriods
docs: Updates the remaining periods of the credit line.
* `num_of_periods` - The number of periods to add onto the credit line.
Only the EA can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.evaluationAgent} adds ${data.numOfPeriods} periods to credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: initializeExtraAccountMetaList
docs: Initializes the extra account meta list for transfer hook purposes.
Only the pool owner can call this instruction.

display.intent: Set up a tranche token's transfer hook
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOwner} sets up the transfer-hook account list of tranche token ${accounts.trancheMint} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: makeInitialDeposit
docs: Allows the pool owner and EA to make initial deposit before the pool goes live.
* `assets` - The amount of underlying tokens to be deposited.
The number of tranche token to be minted.
Only authorized initial depositors can call this instruction.

display.label: Pool Owner Treasury or Evaluation Agent

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.depositor} makes an initial deposit of ${data.assets} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} into tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} of pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, for tranche tokens paid to ${accounts.depositorTrancheToken}

instructions.name: makePayment
docs: Makes one payment for the credit line. This can be initiated by the borrower
or by Sentinel Service account with the allowance approval from the borrower.
If this is the final payment, it automatically triggers the payoff process.
Warning: payments should be made by calling this instruction. No token should be transferred
* `amount_to_collect` - The actual amount paid to the pool. When the tendered
amount is larger than the payoff amount, the contract only accepts the payoff amount.
* `paid_off` - A flag indicating whether the account has been paid off.
Only the borrower and the Sentinel Service account can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} pays at most ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from ${accounts.borrowerUnderlyingToken} toward credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: makePaymentOnBehalfOf
docs: Makes one payment for the credit line by the pool owner treasury on behalf of the borrower.
If this is the final payment, it automatically triggers the payoff process.
* `amount_to_collect` - The actual amount paid to the pool. When the tendered
amount is larger than the payoff amount, the contract only accepts the payoff amount.
* `paid_off` - A flag indicating whether the account has been paid off.
Only payment delegates for the borrower can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.paymentDelegate} pays at most ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from ${accounts.paymentDelegateUnderlyingToken} toward credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig} on the borrower's behalf

instructions.name: makePrincipalPayment
docs: Makes a payment towards the principal for the credit line. Even if there is additional
amount remaining after the principal is paid off, this instruction will only accept the
amount up to the total principal due. If this is the final payment, it automatically
Warning: payments should be made by calling this instruction. No token should be transferred
* `amount_to_collect` - The actual amount paid to the pool. When the tendered
amount is larger than the payoff amount, the contract only accepts the payoff amount.
* `paid_off` - A flag indicating whether the account has been paid off.
Only the borrower can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.borrower} pays at most ${data.amount} of ${accounts.underlyingMint} from ${accounts.borrowerUnderlyingToken} toward the principal of credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}

instructions.name: pauseProtocol
docs: Pauses the entire protocol. Used in extreme cases by the pausers.
This instruction will not be governed by timelock due to its sensitivity to timing.
Only pausers can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.pauser} pauses the entire Huma protocol

instructions.name: refreshCredit
docs: Updates the account and brings its billing status current.

display.interpolatedIntent: Brings the billing status of credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig} up to date

instructions.name: removeApprovedLender
docs: Removes a lender. This prevents the lender from making more deposits.
The capital that the lender has contributed will continue to work as normal.
It is intentional not to delete `DepositRecord` for the lender so that they do not
lose existing investment. They can request redemption post removal as a lender.
Because of lockup period and pool liquidity constraints, we cannot automatically
disburse the investment by this lender.
Only pool operators can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.poolOperator} removes ${data.lender} as an approved lender of tranche ${accounts.trancheMint} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}: they can make no more deposits

instructions.name: removeLiquidityAsset
docs: Removes an asset so that it can no longer serve as the underlying asset for the pools.
Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} removes ${accounts.mint} from the assets Huma pools may use

instructions.name: removePauser
docs: * `pauser` - The address to be removed from the pauser list.
Only the Huma owner can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.owner} removes ${data.pauser} as a pauser of the Huma protocol

instructions.name: removePaymentDelegate
docs: Removes a payment delegate for a borrower.
* `account` - The pubkey of the payment delegate.
If the payment delegate was added by the EA, only the EA can remove them. Otherwise,
Both the borrower and the EA can remove them.

accounts.name: rentRecipient
docs: The recipient for the `PaymentDelegateConfig` rent refund.
recipient must match the address of the signer when the payment delegate was added.

instructions.name: removePoolOperator

instructions.name: removeYieldDistributingLender

instructions.name: setAdminRnr

instructions.name: startCommittedCredit
docs: Initiates a credit line with a committed amount on the designated start date.
This instruction is intended to be used for credit lines where there is a minimum borrowing
commitment. If the borrower fails to drawdown the committed amount within the set timeframe,
this instruction activates the credit line and applies yield based on the committed amount.
Only the EA and the Sentinel Service account can call this instruction.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} starts committed credit line ${accounts.creditConfig} in pool ${accounts.poolConfig}, charging yield on its committed amount

instructions.name: withdrawPoolOwnerFees

instructions.name: withdrawProtocolFees

definedTypes.name: accruedIncomes
docs: The incomes accrued by pool admins.
* `protocol_income` - The cumulative amount of income accrued by the Huma owner.
* `pool_owner_income` - The cumulative amount of income accrued by the pool owner.
* `ea_income` - The cumulative amount of income accrued by the Evaluation Agent.

definedTypes.name: adminRnR
docs: Rewards and Responsibilities for pool admins.
* `reward_rate_bps_for_ea` - Percentage (in bps) of pool income allocated to EA.
* `reward_rate_bps_for_pool_owner` - Percentage (in bps) of pool income allocated to the pool owner.
* `liquidity_rate_bps_for_ea` - Percentage (in bps) of the liquidity cap to be contributed by EA in the junior tranche.
* `liquidity_rate_bps_for_pool_owner` - Percentage (in bps) of the liquidity cap to be contributed by the pool owner in the junior tranche.

display.label: Evaluation Agent's Share of Pool Income
Pool Owner's Share of Pool Income
Evaluation Agent's Junior Liquidity (Share of the Cap)
Pool Owner's Junior Liquidity (Share of the Cap)

definedTypes.name: createReceivableArgs
docs: * `uri` - The URI of the metadata associated with the receivable.
* `currency_code` - The currency code that the receivable is denominated in.
This could be either the ISO 4217 code for fiat currencies or crypto currency code.
* `receivable_amount` - The total amount of the receivable.
* `maturity_date` - The date on which the receivable becomes due.
* `reference_id` - A unique internal reference ID used for de-duplication by the creator.

display.label: Maturity Date (Timestamp as Given; Milliseconds in Executed Receivables)

definedTypes.name: creditRecord
docs: Keeps track of the dynamic stats of a credit that change from pay period to pay period,
e.g. due info for each bill.
* `unbilled_principal` - The amount of principal not included in the bill.
* `next_due_date` - The due date of the next payment.
* `next_due` - The due amount of the next payment. This does not include past due.
* `yield_due` - The yield due for the next payment.
* `total_past_due` - The sum of late fee + past due. See `DueDetail` for more info.
* `missed_periods` - The number of consecutive missed payments, for default processing.
* `remaining_periods` - The number of payment periods until the maturity of the credit.
* `status` - The status of the credit, e.g. `GoodStanding`, `Delayed`, `Defaulted`.

definedTypes.name: creditType
docs: The type of credit that the pool supports.
* `CreditLine` - Regular credit line that does not require collateral.
* `ReceivableBackedCreditLine` - Credit line that requires backing by receivables.

definedTypes.name: depositRecord
docs: The information related to a lender's deposit.
* `principal` - The total amount of underlying assets deposited by the lender.
* `last_deposit_time` - The time the lender deposited into the pool.

definedTypes.name: dueDetail
docs: The detailed information about next due and past due.
This struct is necessary since commitment requirement might change within a period.
* `late_fee_updated_date` - The most recent date when late fee was updated.
* `late_fee` - The late charges only. It is always updated together with lateFeeUpdatedDate.
* `committed` - The amount of yield computed from commitment set in CreditConfig.
* `accrued` - The amount of yield based on actual usage.
* `paid` - The amount of yield paid for the current period.

definedTypes.name: epochRedemptionSummary
docs: The summary of redemption information of an epoch.
* `total_shares_requested` - The total number of shares requested for redemption in this epoch.
* `total_shares_processed` - The total number of shares processed for redemption in this epoch.
* `total_amount_processed` - The total amount redeemed in this epoch.

definedTypes.name: feeStructure
docs: * `front_loading_fee_flat` - Part of platform fee, charged as a flat amount when borrowing occurs.
* `front_loading_fee_bps` - Part of platform fee, charged as a % of the borrowing amount when borrowing occurs.
* `late_fee_bps` - The late fee rate expressed in bps. The late fee is the additional charge on top of the yield
when a payment is late, and is calculated as a % of the total outstanding balance.

definedTypes.name: incomeWithdrawn
docs: The incomes withdrawn by pool admins.
* `protocol_income_withdrawn` - The cumulative amount of income withdrawn by the Huma owner.
* `pool_owner_income_withdrawn` - The cumulative amount of income withdrawn by the pool owner.
* `ea_income_withdrawn` - The cumulative amount of income withdrawn by the Evaluation Agent.

definedTypes.name: lpconfig
docs: * `liquidity_cap` - The max liquidity allowed for the pool.
* `max_senior_junior_ratio` - The upper bound of senior-to-junior ratio allowed.
* `fixed_senior_yield_bps` - The fixed yield for senior tranche. Either this or tranches_risk_adjustment_bps is non-zero.
* `tranches_risk_adjustment_bps` - Percentage of yield to be shifted from senior to junior. Either this or fixed_senior_yield_bps is non-zero.
* `withdrawal_lockup_period_days` - How long a lender has to wait after the last deposit before they can withdraw.
* `auto_redemption_after_lockup` - When enabled, lenders' shares are automatically redeemed after the lockup period.

definedTypes.name: lenderRedemptionRecord
docs: The information related to a lender's redemption.
* `next_epoch_id_to_process` - The next epoch ID for redemption processing.
* `num_shares_requested` - The number of shares requested for redemption in this epoch.
* `principal_requested` - The principal amount included in the redemption request.
* `total_amount_processed` - The total amount processed for redemption in all epochs.
* `total_amount_withdrawn` - The total amount withdrawn by the lender. The withdrawable amount

definedTypes.name: payPeriodDuration
docs: This library defines functions for date calculation. All inputs and outputs are in UTC.
We use the 30/360 day count convention in this implementation, which treats every month as
having 30 days and every year as having 360 days, regardless of the actual number of days in a
month/year. This is a common practice in corporate finance.

definedTypes.name: poolSettings
docs: * `max_credit_line` - The maximum credit line for a borrower in terms of the amount of the underlying assets.
* `min_deposit_amount` - The minimum amount a lender needs to supply each time they deposit.
This is also the absolute minimum balance the pool owner needs to maintain in tranches to prevent
* `pay_period_duration` - The number of months in one pay period.
* `late_payment_grace_period_days` - The grace period before a late fee can be charged, in the unit of number of days.
* `default_grace_period_days` - The grace period before a default can be triggered, in days. This can be 0.
* `advance_rate_bps` - Specifies the max credit line as a percentage (in basis points) of the receivable amount.
for a receivable of $100 with an advance rate of 9000 bps, the credit line can be up to $90.
* `receivable_auto_approval` - Specifies whether receivables should be automatically approved during initial drawdown. If `false`, then
receivables need to be approved prior to the first drawdown.
* `principal_only_payment_allowed` - Specifies whether the `make_principal_payment()` functionality is allowed.
* `credit_type` - The type of credit that the pool supports.

definedTypes.name: poolStatus
docs: * `Off` - The pool is temporarily turned off.
* `Closed` - The pool is closed after maturity.

definedTypes.name: seniorYieldTracker
docs: Tracks the amount of assets and unpaid yield for the senior tranche.
* `total_assets` - The total assets in the senior tranche.
* `unpaid_yield` - The amount of unpaid yield to the senior tranche.
* `last_updated_date` - The last time the tracker was updated.
